intents.name: unclear
intents.description: Messages that are completely unclassifiable - empty, gibberish, or contain no useful information about any issue.
examples: @AppleSupport
Thank you so much!
Hi
Help
Please
Yes
No
Ok
Thanks

You guys are the best

intents.boundary_notes: ONLY use this intent for messages that are truly unclassifiable. Even short messages with keywords like 'ios', 'battery', 'crash', 'app', 'login' should be classified into one of the 5 specific intents. This is the LAST resort.

resolution_heuristics.description: Defines what constitutes a 'resolved' thread for retrieval purposes
criteria: Thread ends with customer message containing gratitude keywords (thank, thanks, appreciate) AND customer did not report ongoing issue
Thread ends with customer confirming issue is fixed (working, worked, resolved, got them back)
Brand responded with ACTUAL TROUBLESHOOTING (not just 'DM us') AND customer did not follow up with complaint
Thread has 2+ turns and brand provided solution (not just deflection)
exclusions: Brand response is ONLY 'DM us' / 'send us a DM' / 'let us know in DM' without any troubleshooting = NOT resolved
Customer expresses continued frustration after brand response = NOT resolved
